notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.52 — Restores the original Call List, all Candidates database and Follow-ups navigation alongside the newer Pipeline and Calendar. The candidate database once again exposes every saved candidate, including those in non-pipeline categories, with status, search, profiles and full history. Call Mode once again shows Notes, previous applications and History openly in the right panel; Recent Calls remain immediately visible on the left instead of being hidden inside a collapsed disclosure. Added one-click Call List / All Candidates buttons in Call Mode and a full-history shortcut to the profile, plus an All Candidates shortcut on Home. No candidate records, recorded attendance, pending official MBL changes, pipeline steps, recruitment timers or official sync actions are deleted or modified. Regression tests cover the navigation, active call-mode history and existing pipeline workflows.
